newsitem.title: USA: Cusiana crude price softens, competition heats up.
newsitem.headline: Cusiana crude price softens, competition heats up.

text.p: Colombia's sweet Cusiana crude is fetching a softer price these days as competition from other sweet crudes begins to heat up, traders said Friday.
British Petroleum sold a 550,000 barrel cargo of Cusiana to U.S. Gulf Coast refiner for delivery January 23-24 at a premium of 10 cents to March West Texas Intermediate, traders said.
A second cargo for January 31 to February 1 is on offer at a similar price, they said.
"Before Christmas, they were at plus 40 cents," one trader noted.
Cusiana and U.S. domestic sweet grades such as Light Louisiana Sweet have come under pressure from the open arbitrage between WTI and North Sea Brent.
Brent for delivery to the Gulf Coast February 15-20 is now on offer at February WTI minus 25 cents.
But U.S. refinery demand remains sluggish amid slim margins.
